text:
diego_seo: Quick SEO sync for the launch + webinar funnel. Need keywords -> pages, small schema, internal link anchors, and redirects for any retired promos.

julia_growth: Goals: 1) publish launch post tied to benchmark narrative, 2) webinar landing with gated download, 3) route inbound leads to HubSpot/SDR.

sara_writer: Keyword seeds: llm-inference-costs; low-latency-llm-serving; production-llm-best-practices; dedicated-vs-hosted-inference; llm-benchmarks-2026. I'll map them to URLs.

diego_seo: URL plan: pillar /benchmarks/llm-inference-2026 (canonical), launch posts under /blog/launch-*, webinar at /webinar/llm-benchmarks-2026. Each launch post -> 2 contextual links to pillar + 1 to webinar.

mike_prod: HubSpot form: capture utm_source, utm_campaign, page_slug as hidden fields. Routing: utm_campaign=webinar_benchmark -> SDR_BENCH queue.

diego_seo: Minimal Event JSON-LD for landing (trimmed): ```json {"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"LLM Serving Benchmarks 2026","startDate":"2026-05-12T16:00:00-07:00","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.example.com/webinar/llm-benchmarks-2026"}} ```

diego_seo: Redirect example for eng (preserve querystring for UTMs): ```nginx
location = /old-promo { return 301 https://redwood.example.com/benchmarks/llm-inference-2026$request_uri; }
```

julia_growth: Prelaunch checklist: meta title <=70 chars, meta desc ~150 chars, OG image, structured data present, >=2 internal links, canonical tag, sitemap updated.

sara_writer: I'll post the keyword->url spreadsheet and sample meta copy by EOD Thursday.

diego_seo: seo-bot, run daily crawl of /benchmarks/llm-inference-2026 for 7 days after publish; alert #marketing if >50 404s.

seo-bot: scheduled: content-crawl /benchmarks/llm-inference-2026; frequency: daily; window: 7d; alert-channel: #marketing; threshold: 50 404s.

mike_prod: Prelaunch review call booked tomorrow 09:30 PT.

diego_seo: Thanks team :rocket:
